correctness.rationale: For every k>=2, prove complementary regular-simplex free-sum structure and exactly k^2 facets. Solve the support equations uniquely in the 2k-2-dimensional zero-sum tangent space to obtain explicit integer normals and exact norm square k[k-1+2d(k-1-d)]. Cyclic averaging proves barycenter optimal; maximizing the concave offset product proves radius/contact counts. Feasible-center inequalities plus cyclic cancellation and an open slack for noncontact facets prove center dimension equals codimension of contact-span, calculated via the difference map and diagonal differences. The proof checks all k and endpoints d=0,k-1, both parity cases. Exact rational solves k2..7, shell/contact ranks k2..14, hull facets k2..6 passed; finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Alternating-cycle root/edge polytopes are canonical lattice polytopes with well studied combinatorics. Their intrinsic Euclidean facet support distances and optimal inscribed-ball geometry are natural realization-sensitive invariants not supplied by Ehrhart counts. The exact k^2 plane-shell structure, parity change k to 2k of nearest facets, and particularly abrupt change from unique center to (k-1)-dimensional optimal-center locus are motivated structural effects not a routine numerical slice. The theorem holds uniformly in the dimension parameter and includes a certificate by active facet normals.
